description: Find the best yearly split of retirement savings between traditional and Roth 401(k), IRA/backdoor Roth, HSA and brokerage, including employer match, Roth conversions and retirement withdrawals. Returns this year's dollars per account, how the optimal mix compares with always-traditional and always-Roth, Roth share, lifetime totals, the first working years and retirement milestones. Runs in a few seconds (a few more with exact_income_limits). All money in today's dollars. Optimal for the stated assumptions; not tax advice. Call get_contribution_example first if unsure of the shape.

accounts.description: Which accounts the user can use. Defaults: 401(k) and Roth 401(k) available, IRA allowed, no HSA, no match.

has_roth_401k.description: Plan offers a Roth 401(k) option. Default true.

hsa.description: HSA-eligible health plan coverage. Default none.

ira.description: May contribute to an IRA / Roth IRA. Default true.

match.description: Your employer match tiers, richest first.

items.description: One employer-match tier: 'employer adds match_pct cents per dollar you put in, on the next of_first_pct_of_pay percent of pay'.

match_pct.description: Employer match rate in whole percent (100 = dollar for dollar, 50 = 50 cents per dollar).

of_first_pct_of_pay.description: WIDTH of this tier in whole percent of pay (not cumulative). '100% of the first 3% then 50% of the next 2%' = [{100,3},{50,2}].

items.description: One employer-match tier: 'employer adds match_pct cents per dollar you put in, on the next of_first_pct_of_pay percent of pay'.

match_pct.description: Employer match rate in whole percent (100 = dollar for dollar, 50 = 50 cents per dollar).

of_first_pct_of_pay.description: WIDTH of this tier in whole percent of pay (not cumulative). '100% of the first 3% then 50% of the next 2%' = [{100,3},{50,2}].

age.description: Your age this year. The plan starts now.

assumptions.description: Modeling assumptions; the defaults are reported back.

backdoor_roth.description: Roth IRA open at any income via backdoor. Default true.

exact_income_limits.description: Model exact Roth IRA / deduction income phase-outs (slower MILP, a few seconds). Default false.

real_return_pct.description: Investment return above inflation, whole percent. Default 5.

retirement_tax_rate_pct.description: Income tax rate applied to leftover traditional money at the end of the plan. Default 22.

state_tax_pct.description: Flat state income tax rate, whole percent. Default 0.

brokerage_gain.description: Unrealized long-term gain inside the brokerage balance (cannot exceed it).

children_birth_years.description: Birth years of dependent children (child tax credit, head of household).

end_age.description: Plan until this age (default 92; horizon at most 90 years).

filing.description: Tax filing status. Default 'single'. 'married' = one joint return; fill in the spouse_* fields.

real_raise_pct.description: Yearly raise above inflation, whole percent (1 = 1%). Default 1.

retire_age.description: Age you stop working. Must be above 'age'.

salary.description: Your gross pay this year, in dollars.

social_security.description: Expected Social Security (household). Omitted = none modeled.

spending_in_retirement.description: Yearly spending after retiring, today's dollars (before income tax).

spending_while_working.description: Yearly living costs while still working, today's dollars. Default = spending_in_retirement.

spouse_retire_age.description: Married only: the age YOU will be when your spouse stops working (all ages on this server are the primary earner's). Default = retire_age.

spouse_salary.description: Married only: spouse's gross pay this year (0 or omitted = spouse does not work).
